text: An AI system that identifies enemy combatants by name and location to target a strike.
An AI system that tracks a specific individual's movements through a city over time.
An AI system that fuses satellite + radar data to locate artillery for defensive counter-battery fire.
An AI system that screens personnel emails for insider-threat indicators.
An AI system that routes humanitarian-aid convoys through contested terrain to minimize civilian exposure.
An AI system that intercepts and decrypts a foreign military's communications.
An AI system that detects chemically-contaminated zones to guide emergency responders away from civilians.
An AI system that predicts a drone's flight path to defend a base from a direct strike.
An AI system that auto-engages a weapons system without human confirmation.
An AI system that maps civilian infrastructure (power, water) to plan a siege.
An AI system that forecasts weather to guide search-and-rescue in a disaster zone.
An AI system that profiles an ethnic group to predict protest participation.
